profile.headline: I build software and I am loving it.
profile.summary: Dedicated software engineer with proven skills for complex and distributed applications for commercial and financial services. Fluent in Java and Javascript programming languages. Capable of full software development life cycle to include: requirement gathering, design, coding, testing, verification, deployment and support.

positions.title: Technical Lead in Identity Management and Security
Client Identity Software Engineer
positions.description: Integrate Single-Sign-On and Federated Identity Management across internal and external systems.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Modernize the online banking internal and public facing services by migrating existing SOAP services to RESTful microservices.  Use Domain Driven Design concept along with Node.js technology to re-architect simple microservices that are stable and performant.

Major accomplishments:
1) Lead technical team to migrate SOAP service infrastructure to the RESTful microservices architecture.
2) Leverage Docker container to allow services to scale horizontally.
3) Improve code quality by introducing Test Driven Development and Cucumber test to automate regression test.
4) Improve service security by using OAuth token to authenticate/authorize distributed systems.

positions.title: Senior Application Engineer
positions.description:
I developed highly cohesive and least coupling software in order to lower the cost of maintenance. Domain Driven Design concept is highly leverage to decompose existing monolith into microservices.

I provide value in four areas:
1) Enable scalable business through independently developed services.
2) Eliminate accidental complexity by aggressively retire and replace unnecessarily complex processes.
3) Support innovation in existing markets by allowing new technology to be easily introduced to current products.
4) Reduce inertia with design choices that favor rapid feedback and change, with reduced dependencies across teams.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer responsible for RESTful API development. Duties include: design, code, refactor, unit test, and provide Single-Sign On integration support. Develop SaaS system using Java, Spring, Javascript, MySQL, and Microservices concept.

positions.title: ESB Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer responsible for Middleware Software Development. Duties include: design, coding, unit testing, deployment into production, and providing support. Applications include key financial Single-Sign On services, OAuth service, Service Directory, and enterprise service bus (ESB).  Programs coded in Java and C#.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of Software Engineering Team responsible for developing key web based applications. Developed and maintained web-based test delivery system for the Defense Language Institute (DLI) using J2EE, Struts, JSP, and Weblogic technologies. As a lead software developer, performed software full life cycle development by documenting business requirements and technical specifications. Also, designed and architected main components, prototyped and implemented the end products.  Worked closely with the QA team to develop user acceptance testing, and worked with configuration management team to deploy the software in the field.  Corrected software defects, added software enhancements, and addressed defects in the system.

Worked on DBIDS project to include design, development and maintained software to enforce physical security using biometric technology that is in used by military bases all over the world.
Improved security screening by adding new software feature that automatically scanned for Known/Suspected Terrorist from an actively updated watch list.  Integrated additional components to include Identix fingerprint reader and 3M Passport Reader to enhance the authentication process and strengthen security to military bases. As the lead developer, I negotiated deliverables with customer in order to finish project within time and budget. Worked with 3rd party hardware suppliers to develop adaptable product to meet client’s needs.

positions.title: Programmer/Consultant
positions.description:
Designed, developed and maintained large scale window applications for the Tourism Industry.
The technology used was MS SQL Server 2000, C#.NET Framework. Also maintained legacy code in VB6 and improved team productivity by writing support codes that automated repetitive tasks.
Documented technology infrastructure and services to improve knowledge transfer and cross duty training.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained large scale Java web applications that involve social networking and online survey for the purpose of marketing research. Maintained legacy code and provided IT support to a MAC user base of 20 employees.
Managed file server and performed weekly data back up to protect the company's digital assets.
Documented technology infrastructure and services. Implemented new features like intuitive menu to improve the user interface of the existing software.
